Consequently, every testable checkpoint was marked 'false' because the visual features (spotted shell, blunt snout, terrestrial feet) fundamentally contradict the Mud Turtle taxonomy (smooth dark shell, pointed snout, webbed feet). The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints; it only marked occluded features (plastron, tail) as untestable, which is correct.
